descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that retrieves fuel prices using the Korea National Oil Corporation’s Opinet general API.
descriptions.ko: 한국석유공사 **오피넷(Opinet) 일반 API**를 사용해 유가 정보를 가져오는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합구성요소입니다.

categories_review.source: Opinet general API provides nationwide fuel averages and station fuel selling prices (README Sensors/Services; https://www.opinet.co.kr/user/custapi/custApiInfo.do). Primary category energy.energy_prices describes this energy-price service directly; no secondary category is needed. Taxonomy: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c/homeassistant/generated/integration_categories.json (reviewed 2026-10-20).
